body.name: Pretreatment residual lag covariance
body.construction: Set \(\widehat M^{\mathrm{pre}}=\mathcal P_r(Y^{\mathrm{obs}}_{I\times S})\), \(\widehat e_{is}=Y^{\mathrm{obs}}_{is}-\widehat M^{\mathrm{pre}}_{is}\), and \(\widehat\gamma(h)=\{N(m-|h|)\}^{-1}\sum_{i=1}^N\sum_{s\in S:s+|h|\in S}\widehat e_{is}\widehat e_{i,s+|h|}\) for \(|h|\le q\).
